claims.assertion: Alahi said he compared residents’ electromagnetic frequencies with city and planetary measurements to test whether collective consciousness shapes Earth.
claims.speaker: Alahi Eshtar de Erra

claims.assertion: Alahi claimed an average starseed influences the collective field about as much as 1,500 ordinary humans; highly awakened ones may affect tens of thousands or more.
claims.speaker: Alahi Eshtar de Erra
claims.qualifiers: He described these as estimates from his measurements.

claims.assertion: He said starseeds influence Earth’s collective field simply by existing; connecting with peers amplifies them, though the human average can pull them down.
claims.speaker: Alahi Eshtar de Erra

review_flags: Numerical influence estimates and the measurement interpretation are attributed to Alahi.
